messages.subject: how to decently exit execution
parts:
I feel rather stupid, but I do not understand how to stop the execution of a rApache script. I test the GET parameters, and if they are not consistent, I want to quit with an error message on screen. But quit() or error() (setContentType and setStatus) causes server errors, without decent message. Of course an if(...) {.....} else{.....} works, but there must be a more simple way. In the documentation "custom error messages"are mentioned, but I do not understand this section.
Thank you very much
Frans

messages.author: 3ea57457192f4f3b
messages.subject: Re: how to decently exit execution
parts: Have a look at opencpu. Its builds on rapache, and automatically deals with all this stuff for you. E.g. you can just use stop() in your script and it will automatically return a http400 with the error message in the body.
